base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev hdf5-tools libhdf5-openmpi-dev
setup_runtime_commands: pip install numpy astropy healpy pandas fitsio pyarrow tables

runtime_profile.notes: MPI-enabled Python environment for pz-rail. The environment includes MPI and HDF5 system libraries for mpi4py and h5py. JAX is installed for GPU-accelerated computations. The pz-rail package is installed in editable mode from /workspace.

notes: Base image python:3.11-slim recommended. git and curl are included in system_packages. The environment uses a Python venv at /opt/benchmark/venv. MPI and HDF5 system libraries are required for mpi4py and h5py. The pz-rail package is installed in editable mode so changes to /workspace are reflected immediately.
